card.name: Hiro's Shadow Scout
card.effectSummary: Ao ser virado para cima, o oponente compra três cartas; as cartas são reveladas e as Magias entre elas são enviadas ao Cemitério.

behavior.draw: top three cards from only the opposing active physical seat's private Deck
behavior.reveal: all three drawn identities are exposed to both teams
behavior.discard: only Spell Cards move to the opponent team's shared Graveyard; Trap and Monster cards remain in the active opponent's private hand
behavior.deckOut: fewer than three cards follows classic drawCards semantics: no partial draw and immediate loss
behavior.handLimit: 6 checked only at End Phase; no early discard
behavior.ownership: preserve m0-m3 UID; do not rewrite physical owner
behavior.zones: 3 monster + 3 spell/trap per team; Field Zone separate
behavior.deck: 20-30 main deck per physical seat; Extra Deck maximum 5
